stages.name: Observe
stages.instruction: The particle exits the emitter with speed $v$ into a uniform magnetic field $B$ pointing out of the page ($\odot$). Slide $v$ and $B$, toggle the charge sign, and fire. Watch how the circle radius $r$ and rotation sense change.
stages.concept: Lorentz force: $\vec{F} = q\,\vec{v} \times \vec{B}$. Perpendicular to $\vec{v}$, so the speed stays constant and the trajectory closes into a circle of radius $r = \dfrac{m v}{|q| B}$ with angular frequency $\omega = \dfrac{|q| B}{m}$.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.instruction: Hit all three targets. The dashed preview circle shows the trajectory for the current $v$, $B$, and charge sign. If a target sits above the initial velocity line, flip the charge sign to reverse the rotation.
stages.concept: $r = \dfrac{m v}{|q| B}$ — smaller $B$ gives a wider circle. Sign of $q$ decides which side of the initial velocity the centre lies on: $q > 0$ curves down, $q < 0$ curves up (for $\vec{B}$ out of the page).

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.instruction: No preview. Each target's coordinates $(x, y)$ are shown. Compute $r$, then solve for $B$ from $r = \dfrac{m v}{|q| B}$. You have exactly one shot per target — no spray-and-pray.
stages.concept: For a target at $(x, y)$ on the circle through the origin, $r = \dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{2\,|y|}$. Sign of $y$ tells you the sign of $q$: target above $(y > 0) \Rightarrow q < 0$; target below $(y < 0) \Rightarrow q > 0$.

labels.tip1: change v, B, and the charge sign — watch how the circle moves
labels.tip2: line the dashed circle up so it passes through each target, then FIRE
labels.tip3: read (x, y), solve r and B on paper, pick the charge sign — then FIRE
labels.peek_tip_radius: r = mv/(|q|B). Same r ⇒ many (v, B) pairs. Halving B doubles r.
labels.peek_tip_sign: Sign of q flips rotation. Target above y = 0 ⇒ q must be negative.
labels.peek_tip_geometry: For a target on the circle through the origin, r = (x² + y²) / (2·|y|).

1.1: Move the v slider (left) and the B slider (right) — the dashed circle updates live.
1.2: Toggle q from +e to −e. The centre of the circle jumps from below to above the initial velocity.
1.3: Larger v ⇒ larger r. Larger B ⇒ smaller r. r = mv/(|q|B).

2.1: Move the dashed preview circle over each target, then fire. It has to pass THROUGH the target.
2.2: Wider circle ⇒ lower B (or higher v). Tighter circle ⇒ higher B (or lower v).
2.3: If a target sits above the emitter's horizontal line, you can't reach it with q = +e. Flip q to −e first.

3.1: For each target: read (x, y). Compute r = (x² + y²) / (2·|y|). Then B = mv/(|q|·r).
3.2: Pick the sign of q from the sign of y: target below ⇒ q = +e; target above ⇒ q = −e.
3.3: Pick any v in range and compute B from B = v / r (sim units) — many (v, B) pairs share the same r.
